How to play

An alien swarm is crawling out of the rift. Protect your base across 12 lands, from a desert outpost to an alien crash site, with 10 waves in each. Every game gets a new, much longer map: swipe in any direction to scroll, pinch or use the − and + buttons to zoom, and use ⌖ and ⌂ to jump to the action or your base.

Your road starts 18 tiles long. Before each wave you pick one of three cards: a free weapon, an upgrade, or a road piece you place yourself at the portal end so the aliens walk farther. Drag the piece to move it and tap it to rotate. You can refresh the cards every other turn. Clear 10 waves to move on to the next land.

Your base defends itself with two Gatling turrets and a missile launcher, but it can't hold alone. Barracks troopers block ground monsters and shoot air too. Select a barracks, then tap the path to move them.

Heroes: before every wave you pick one of six heroes. Tap near the road to set their patrol zone; they fight inside that ring. Their three abilities sit at the bottom right. Tap the hero portrait to move the patrol zone.

Tip: on iPhone, use Share, then Add to Home Screen, to play full screen.
